guestSession.name: zq_guest_<restaurant UUID without hyphens>
guestSession.description: Dynamic per-restaurant signed HttpOnly cookie issued by GET /commerce/{restaurantId}/session. Cart/order/reservation IDs alone grant no access. Expires in 30 days. Never send in a URL.

guestCsrf.name: X-Guest-CSRF
guestCsrf.description: Session-bound HMAC returned by GET /commerce/{restaurantId}/session; required for guest and authenticated commerce mutations. Existing account sessions ALSO require X-CSRF-Token.

csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf.description: Account cookie mutations require the matching zayqora_csrf cookie value in this header, in addition to any guest CSRF header.

Error.description: User-safe error with stable code and request ID
